metadata.description: Apra Labs skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers for Claude Code

plugins.name: bitbucket
plugins.description: Bitbucket Cloud done right: REST and git authentication (API tokens with scopes, access tokens), repos, code, pull requests and reviews, pipelines and logs, deployments. The token stays in apra-fleet. Requires apra-fleet 0.4.4+ and Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: rport
plugins.description: Guardrails for RPort servers (rportd/openrport): stored tunnels, revive, expiry, repointing fleet members, running reviewed library scripts on one client, and explaining script run history (who, what, when, effects); the API token stays in apra-fleet. Requires apra-fleet 0.4.4+ and Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: The GitHub work agents get wrong, done safely: explicit identity (fleet secret, fleet GitHub App, gh login or App key), Discussions and a Discussions FAQ, PR review threads and valid inline comments, sub-issues and issue types, Actions failure triage. Complements gh. Requires Node.js 18+.

plugins.name: stop-agents
plugins.description: Stops Claude Code background agents with one command, inside Claude (/stop-agents:stop) or from any terminal (stop-agents). Never stops its own session. The bash version needs jq, python3 or python.

plugins.name: password-gen
plugins.description: Strong random passwords the agent never sees: straight to the clipboard (auto-cleared), to your terminal's clipboard over SSH (OSC 52), or piped by you into a secret store. Windows, macOS, Linux. Requires Node.js 18+.
